entities.summary: Vostanik Marukhyan in Yerevan, Armenia was a Rector of State Engineering University of Armenia from 2006 to 2011, t.s.c. professor, full member of Engineering Academy, member of the National Assembly of Armenia, chairman of "Thermal Power Engineering and Protection of Environment" of department Power Engineering of SEUA.
